
Packages and libraries to be used later.
```{r}
#Install required packages.
install.packages(c("ggplot2", "lsmeans", "metropolis", "MCMCpack", "CompRiskRel"))
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(lsmeans)
library(metropolis)
library(coda)
library(MCMCpack)
library(CompRiskRel)
```

Set True parameter values.
```{r}
Truebeta_0 <- 1; Truebeta_1 <- 2; Truebeta_2 <- -1; Truetau <- 1
true_values <- c(Beta0 = Truebeta_0, Beta1 = Truebeta_1, Beta2 = Truebeta_2, Tau = Truetau)
```

Data generation.
```{r}
set.seed(4008)
#Sample Sizes.
n_vals <- c(30,250,1000)
#Correlation coefficients.
Rho_vals <- c(0,0.9)
Datasets <- list()
#Counter for loops.
i <- 1
for (n in n_vals) {
  #Generate normal variables.
  X1 <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  Z <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  #Generate error variable.
  Eps <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = sqrt(1/Truetau))
  for (Rho in Rho_vals) {
    #Generate second explanatory variable.
    X2 <- Rho*X1 + sqrt(1-Rho^2)*Z
    #Generate outcome variable.
    Y <- Truebeta_0 + Truebeta_1*X1 + Truebeta_2*X2 + Eps
    #Store data set.
    Data <- data.frame(Y,X1,X2)
    Datasets[[i]] <- Data
    i <- i + 1}}
```

Ordinary Least Squares Estimation.
```{r}
#Storage for all data.
Results_LS <- list()

#Fit for each data set.
for (i in 1:length(Datasets)){
  Data <- Datasets[[i]]
  Results_LS[[i]] <- lm(Y ~ X1 + X2, data = Data)}

#Display results.
for (i in 1:length(Results_LS)) {
  print(paste("Dataset", i))
  print(summary(Results_LS[[i]]))
  print(confint(Results_LS[[i]]))

  #Maximum likelihood estimate of tau.
  RSS <- sum(Results_LS[[i]]$residuals^2)
  n <- nrow(Datasets[[i]])
  Tau_MLE <- n/RSS
  print(paste("Tau:", Tau_MLE))}
```

Hyper parameters setup.
```{r}
beta0mean <- 0; beta1mean <- 0; beta2mean <- 0
beta0var <- 4; beta1var <- 4; beta2var <- 4
taushape <- 2; taurate <- 2
```

Importance Sampling.
```{r}
#Set seed.
set.seed(4008)
#Number of prior samples.
K <- 10000
#Number of posterior samples.
nsamples <- 1000
#Storage for importance sampling results.
Results_IS <- list()

#Apply importance sampling to each dataset.
for (i in 1:length(Datasets)) {
  #Select data set.
  Data <- Datasets[[i]]
  Y <- Data$Y
  X1 <- Data$X1
  X2 <- Data$X2

  #Generate samples from the prior distributions.
  beta0_samples <- rnorm(K, beta0mean, sqrt(beta0var))
  beta1_samples <- rnorm(K, beta1mean, sqrt(beta1var))
  beta2_samples <- rnorm(K, beta2mean, sqrt(beta2var))
  tau_samples <- rgamma(K, shape = taushape, rate = taurate)

  #Storage for log weights.
  logweights <- numeric(K)
  #Calculate log weights.
  for (j in 1:K) {logweights[j] <- sum(dnorm(Y,mean = beta0_samples[j] + beta1_samples[j]*X1 + beta2_samples[j]*X2, sd = sqrt(1/tau_samples[j]),log = TRUE))}
  #Calculate weights.
  weights <- exp(logweights - max(logweights))
  weights <- weights/sum(weights)

  #Calculate posterior means.
  posterior_means <- c(Beta0 = sum(weights*beta0_samples),Beta1 = sum(weights*beta1_samples),Beta2 = sum(weights*beta2_samples),Tau = sum(weights*tau_samples))

  #Generate posterior samples.
  selected <- sample(1:K, size = nsamples,replace = TRUE, prob = weights)
  posterior_beta0 <- beta0_samples[selected]
  posterior_beta1 <- beta1_samples[selected]
  posterior_beta2 <- beta2_samples[selected]
  posterior_tau <- tau_samples[selected]

  #Store results.
  Results_IS[[i]] <- list(Means = posterior_means,Beta0 = posterior_beta0,Beta1 = posterior_beta1,Beta2 = posterior_beta2,Tau = posterior_tau)}
```

```{r}
#Display importance sampling results.
for (i in 1:length(Results_IS)) {
  print(paste("Dataset", i))
  print(Results_IS[[i]]$Means)}

#Calculate 95% credible intervals.
for (i in 1:length(Results_IS)) {
  print(paste("Dataset", i))

  print(quantile(Results_IS[[i]]$Beta0, c(0.025, 0.975)))
  print(quantile(Results_IS[[i]]$Beta1, c(0.025, 0.975)))
  print(quantile(Results_IS[[i]]$Beta2, c(0.025, 0.975)))
  print(quantile(Results_IS[[i]]$Tau, c(0.025, 0.975)))}
for (i in seq_along(Results_IS)) {
  cat("Dataset", i, "\n")
  print(abs(Results_IS[[i]]$Means - true_values))
}
```

Metropolis-Hastings.
```{r}
#Calculate log posterior.
logposterior <- function(param, Data) {
  beta0 <- param[1]
  beta1 <- param[2]
  beta2 <- param[3]
  tau <- exp(param[4])

  #Calculate log likelihood.
  loglikelihood <- sum(dnorm(Data$Y,mean = beta0 + beta1*Data$X1 + beta2*Data$X2, sd = sqrt(1/tau), log = TRUE))
  #Calculate log prior.
  logprior <- dnorm(beta0, beta0mean, sqrt(beta0var), log = TRUE) +
              dnorm(beta1, beta1mean, sqrt(beta1var), log = TRUE) +
              dnorm(beta2, beta2mean, sqrt(beta2var), log = TRUE) +
              dgamma(tau, shape = taushape, rate = taurate, log = TRUE)
  #Return log posterior.
  return(loglikelihood + logprior + param[4])}
```


```{r}
#Set seed.
set.seed(4008)
#Number of iterations.
iterations <- 10000
#Number of burn-in iterations.
burnin <- 2000
#Storage for Metropolis-Hastings results.
Results_MH <- list()

#Apply Metropolis-Hastings to each dataset.
for (i in 1:length(Datasets)) {
  #Select dataset.
  Data <- Datasets[[i]]

  #Set starting values manually.
  current <- c(0, 0, 0, log(1))
  #Set proposal standard deviations.
  n <- nrow(Data)
  proposal_sd <- c(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.2)*sqrt(30/n)
  #Storage for samples.
  chain <- matrix(0, nrow = iterations, ncol = 4)
  accepted <- 0
  #Calculate initial log posterior.
  current_logpost <- logposterior(current, Data)

  #Metropolis-Hastings iterations.
  for (j in 1:iterations) {
    #Generate proposed parameter values.
    proposed <- c(rnorm(1, mean = current[1], sd = proposal_sd[1]),rnorm(1, mean = current[2], sd = proposal_sd[2]),rnorm(1, mean = current[3], sd = proposal_sd[3]), rnorm(1, mean = current[4], sd = proposal_sd[4]))

    #Calculate proposed log posterior.
    proposed_logpost <- logposterior(proposed, Data)
    #Accept or reject proposal.
    if (log(runif(1)) < proposed_logpost - current_logpost) {
      current <- proposed
      current_logpost <- proposed_logpost
      accepted <- accepted + 1}

    #Store current values.
    chain[j,] <- current}
  
  #Remove burn-in samples.
  chain <- chain[(burnin+1):iterations,]

  #Convert log precision back to precision.
  posterior_tau <- exp(chain[,4])

  #Calculate posterior means.
  posterior_means <- c(Beta0 = mean(chain[,1]),Beta1 = mean(chain[,2]),Beta2 = mean(chain[,3]),Tau = mean(posterior_tau))

  #Store results.
  Results_MH[[i]] <- list(Means = posterior_means,Beta0 = chain[,1],Beta1 = chain[,2],Beta2 = chain[,3],Tau = posterior_tau,Acceptance = accepted/iterations)}
```

Gibbs Sampling.
```{r}
#Gibbs Sampling.

#Set seed.
set.seed(4008)

#Number of iterations.
iterations <- 10000

#Number of burn-in iterations.
burnin <- 2000

#Storage for Gibbs sampling results.
Results_Gibbs <- list()

#Apply Gibbs sampling to each data set.
for (i in 1:length(Datasets)) {
  #Select data set.
  Data <- Datasets[[i]]
  Y <- Data$Y
  X1 <- Data$X1
  X2 <- Data$X2
  n <- length(Y)
  #Set starting values.
  beta0 <- 0; beta1 <- 0; beta2 <- 0; tau <- 1
  #Storage for posterior samples.
  chain <- matrix(0, nrow = iterations, ncol = 4)

  #Gibbs sampling iterations.
  for (j in 1:iterations) {

    #Sample Beta 0.
    postvar0 <- 1/(tau*n + 1/beta0var)
    postmean0 <- postvar0*(tau*sum(Y - beta1*X1 - beta2*X2) + beta0mean/beta0var)
    beta0 <- rnorm(1, postmean0, sqrt(postvar0))

    #Sample Beta 1.
    postvar1 <- 1/(tau*sum(X1^2) + 1/beta1var)

    postmean1 <- postvar1*(tau*sum(X1*(Y - beta0 - beta2*X2)) +beta1mean/beta1var)

    beta1 <- rnorm(1, postmean1, sqrt(postvar1))


    #Sample Beta 2.
    postvar2 <- 1/(tau*sum(X2^2) + 1/beta2var)
    postmean2 <- postvar2*(tau*sum(X2*(Y - beta0 - beta1*X1)) +beta2mean/beta2var)

    beta2 <- rnorm(1, postmean2, sqrt(postvar2))
    
    #Sample Tau.
    RSS <- sum((Y - beta0 - beta1*X1 - beta2*X2)^2)

    postshape <- taushape + n/2
    postrate <- taurate + RSS/2

    tau <- rgamma(1, shape = postshape, rate = postrate)
    #Store current values.
    chain[j,] <- c(beta0, beta1, beta2, tau)}

  #Remove burn-in samples.
  chain <- chain[(burnin+1):iterations,]

  #Calculate posterior means.
  posterior_means <- c(Beta0 = mean(chain[,1]), Beta1 = mean(chain[,2]), Beta2 = mean(chain[,3]),Tau = mean(chain[,4]))

  #Store results.
  Results_Gibbs[[i]] <- list(Means = posterior_means,Beta0 = chain[,1],Beta1 = chain[,2],Beta2 = chain[,3],Tau = chain[,4])}
```

Using packages in R.

```{r}
# Set seed.
set.seed(4008)
# Number of prior samples.
K <- 10000
# Number of posterior samples.
nsamples <- 1000
# Storage for package results.
Results_IS_pkg <- list()

# Define prior distribution.
logprior_IS <- function(param) {
  sum(dnorm(param[1:3],
            mean = c(beta0mean, beta1mean, beta2mean),
            sd = sqrt(c(beta0var, beta1var, beta2var)),
            log = TRUE)) +
    dgamma(param[4], shape = taushape, rate = taurate, log = TRUE)}

# Define proposal distribution (same as prior).
proposal_IS <- function(n) { cbind( rnorm(n, beta0mean, sqrt(beta0var)),rnorm(n, beta1mean, sqrt(beta1var)),rnorm(n, beta2mean, sqrt(beta2var)),rgamma(n, shape = taushape, rate = taurate))}

# Apply importance sampling to each dataset.
for (i in 1:length(Datasets)) {
  # Select dataset.
  Data <- Datasets[[i]]
  # Define log posterior.
  target <- function(param) {sum(dnorm(Data$Y,mean = param[1] + param[2]*Data$X1 + param[3]*Data$X2,sd = sqrt(1/param[4]),log = TRUE)) + logprior_IS(param)}

  # Run package importance sampling.
  fit <- CompRiskRel::importance_sampling_censored(log_target = target,proposal_pdf = function(param) exp(logprior_IS(param)),rproposal = proposal_IS,n_sim = K)

  # Generate posterior samples using package weights.
  selected <- sample(1:K, size = nsamples, replace = TRUE, prob = fit$weights)
  samples <- fit$draws[selected, ]
  # Store results.
  Results_IS_pkg[[i]] <- list(Means = setNames(fit$post_means, c("Beta0", "Beta1", "Beta2", "Tau")), Beta0 = samples[,1], Beta1 = samples[,2], Beta2 = samples[,3], Tau = samples[,4])}
```

```{r}
# Calculate 95% credible intervals.

  print(quantile(Results_IS_pkg[[i]]$Beta0, c(0.025, 0.975)))
  print(quantile(Results_IS_pkg[[i]]$Beta1, c(0.025, 0.975)))
  print(quantile(Results_IS_pkg[[i]]$Beta2, c(0.025, 0.975)))
  print(quantile(Results_IS_pkg[[i]]$Tau, c(0.025, 0.975)))}
```

```{r}
# Set seed.
set.seed(4008)
# Storage for package results.
Results_MH_pkg <- list()
# Apply Metropolis-Hastings to each dataset.
for (i in 1:length(Datasets)) {par(mfrow = c(1,1), mar = c(2,2,2,1))
  # Select data set.
  Data <- Datasets[[i]]
  # Run package Metropolis-Hastings.
  res <- metropolis_glm(Y ~ X1 + X2,data = Data,family = gaussian(),iter = 8000,burnin = 2000,inits = c(0, 0, 0, 0),pm = c(0, beta0mean, beta1mean, beta2mean),pv = c(1, beta0var, beta1var, beta2var),adaptive = TRUE,guided = TRUE,block = FALSE)
  # Convert results to MCMC object.
  res2 <- as.mcmc(res)
  # Store results.
  Results_MH_pkg[[i]] <- res2
  # Display posterior summaries.
  print(paste("Dataset", i))
  print(summary(res2))
  # Plot results.
  plot(res2)}
```

```{r}
# Gibbs Sampling using R package.
# Set seed.
set.seed(4008)

# Storage for package results.
Results_Gibbs_pkg <- list()

# Apply Gibbs sampling to each dataset.
for (i in 1:length(Datasets)) {

  # Select dataset.
  Data <- Datasets[[i]]

  # Run Gibbs sampler.
  fit <- MCMCregress(Y ~ X1 + X2,data = Data,burnin = 2000,mcmc = 8000,thin = 1,seed = 4008 + i,
    # Starting values.
    beta.start = c(0,0,0),
    # Regression coefficient priors.
    b0 = 0,
    B0 = 0.25,

    # Precision prior.
    c0 = 4,
    d0 = 4)
  # Extract posterior samples.
  samples <- as.matrix(fit)

  # Convert variance to precision.
  posterior_tau <- 1/samples[,"sigma2"]

  # Calculate posterior means.
  posterior_means <- c(Beta0 = mean(samples[,"(Intercept)"]),Beta1 = mean(samples[,"X1"]),Beta2 = mean(samples[,"X2"]),Tau = mean(posterior_tau))

  # Store results.
  Results_Gibbs_pkg[[i]] <- list(Means = posterior_means,Beta0 = samples[,"(Intercept)"],Beta1 = samples[,"X1"],Beta2 = samples[,"X2"],Tau = posterior_tau)}
```

Prior sensitivity. 
```{r}
# Prior sensitivity analysis.
set.seed(4008)

# Different coefficient prior variances.
prior_vars <- c(0.25, 4, 25)

# Number of iterations and burn-in.
iterations <- 10000
burnin <- 2000

# Storage for results.
Results_Prior <- list()

for (v in prior_vars) {

  Results_Prior[[as.character(v)]] <- list()

  # Compare small and large datasets.
  for (i in c(1,5)) {

    Data <- Datasets[[i]]
    Y <- Data$Y
    X1 <- Data$X1
    X2 <- Data$X2
    n <- length(Y)

    # Starting values.
    beta0 <- 0; beta1 <- 0; beta2 <- 0; tau <- 1

    # Storage for posterior samples.
    chain <- matrix(0, nrow = iterations, ncol = 4)

    for (j in 1:iterations) {

      # Sample Beta 0.
      postvar0 <- 1/(tau*n + 1/v)
      postmean0 <- postvar0*(tau*sum(Y - beta1*X1 - beta2*X2) + beta0mean/v)
      beta0 <- rnorm(1, postmean0, sqrt(postvar0))

      # Sample Beta 1.
      postvar1 <- 1/(tau*sum(X1^2) + 1/v)
      postmean1 <- postvar1*(tau*sum(X1*(Y - beta0 - beta2*X2)) + beta1mean/v)
      beta1 <- rnorm(1, postmean1, sqrt(postvar1))

      # Sample Beta 2.
      postvar2 <- 1/(tau*sum(X2^2) + 1/v)
      postmean2 <- postvar2*(tau*sum(X2*(Y - beta0 - beta1*X1)) + beta2mean/v)
      beta2 <- rnorm(1, postmean2, sqrt(postvar2))

      # Sample Tau.
      RSS <- sum((Y - beta0 - beta1*X1 - beta2*X2)^2)
      postshape <- taushape + n/2
      postrate <- taurate + RSS/2
      tau <- rgamma(1, shape = postshape, rate = postrate)

      # Store samples.
      chain[j,] <- c(beta0, beta1, beta2, tau)
    }

    # Remove burn-in.
    chain <- chain[(burnin+1):iterations,]
    colnames(chain) <- c("Beta0", "Beta1", "Beta2", "Tau")

    # Posterior means and 95% credible intervals.
    posterior_means <- colMeans(chain)
    credible_intervals <- apply(chain, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

    # Store results.
    Results_Prior[[as.character(v)]][[as.character(i)]] <-
      list(Means = posterior_means,
           CI = credible_intervals,
           Samples = chain)

    # Display results.
    cat("\nPrior variance:", v, "| Dataset:", i, "\n")
    print(round(posterior_means, 3))
    print(round(credible_intervals, 3))
  }
}
```
